description.en: Turns one of the lights of a light object on or off: light number 0 to 8; only the value 1 (or true) turns it on. The skill scenes switch lights per camera cut with it.
true (1) for on, anything else for off.

true once set.
false if the light object is not found or the number is above 8.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 3 arguments are given.

examples.case: Lights per cut (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_skl.nut)
